parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A cabinet door made of MDF, typically finished with a veneer or paint layer, forming the front access panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet by swinging open and closed, often attached with hinges.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about one vertical axis using hinges attached to the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A pull-out drawer made of plywood, located above the cabinet door, used for storing smaller items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a sliding storage compartment for utensils or small objects.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An internal horizontal board made of particle board, dividing the cabinet’s interior space.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the internal space for better organization.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, providing rigidity and shape.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts including the door, drawer, and shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s structure.
parts.Movement_description: It is a static component and does not move.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The bottom support structure of the cabinet made of solid wood, providing stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures balance on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during use.

parts.name: Triangle (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A small triangular component made of plastic, possibly used as a corner bracket or decorative piece.
parts.Functional_description: It may serve as a reinforcement or alignment aid for the cabinet structure.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move.
